rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for stopping or discontinuing an action, whether temporarily or finally.

example.english: The cessation of work at the site is temporary because of the heavy rain.
example.traditional: 工地因為落大雨，暫時停止施工。
example.jyutping: gung1 dei6 jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 zaam6 si4 ting4 zi2 si1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a temporary pause or interruption in an activity or process, rather than a final ending.

example.english: There was a sudden cessation of the discussion halfway through the department meeting, and everyone fell silent.
example.traditional: 部門會議講到一半突然停頓，大家都靜咗落嚟。
example.jyutping: bou6 mun4 wui6 ji5 gong2 dou3 jat1 bun3 dat6 jin4 ting4 deon6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zing6 zo2 lok6 lai4

rows.note: Choose this when the cessation is an explicit termination, especially in formal contexts such as an agreement or proceeding.

example.english: Both sides have formally announced the cessation of the cooperation agreement.
example.traditional: 雙方已正式終止合作協議。
example.jyutping: soeng1 fong1 ji5 zing3 sik1 zung1 zi2 hap6 zok3 hip3 ji5
